function.name: desk_read
function.description: Call before placing a leveraged perp order. Returns where liquidation money is stacked, where your position would be taken out, how far a cascade runs, who is paying funding, and a machine verdict (proceed, reduce or skip) with stop and target suggestions. Free delayed data without a key. Descriptive, not a forecast.

symbol.description: Perp pair, e.g. BTCUSDT. See GET /api/desk_read/symbols.
